"""
================================================================================
STEP 1: B2B TRADING & DISTRIBUTION DATA DESIGN & REALISTIC SIMULATION
Project: Ekatunggal Group (PT Ekatunggal Tunas Mandiri) - Analytics Pipeline
Role: Senior Data Analyst (5 Years Experience)
================================================================================
Business Context & Embedded Anomalies:
1. B2B Channels & Distribution Centers:
   - Cabang Luar Pulau (Makassar & Samarinda): High wholesale volume driven by
     aggressive volume rebates (20-35%), high inter-island shipping/transit fee (10%),
     higher damage/transit return claim rate (~14%), and LOW repeat rate (~13%).
   - Cabang Jawa (Sidoarjo & Semarang): Moderate volume discounts (10-20%),
     regional distribution fee 8%, moderate customer retention (~28%).
   - Gudang Pusat Jabodetabek (Citeureup, Bogor - Direct Factory B2B): Lower volume
     discounts (0-10%), low logistics overhead (2.5%), low damage claim rate (~3%),
     and HIGH client loyalty/retention (~48%).
2. The "Volume Discount Illusion":
   - Sales management looks at Gross Invoiced Volume -> sees massive top-line figures.
   - Finance discovers inter-island transit damage, aggressive volume rebates, and
     regional distributor allowances cause Makassar & Samarinda shipments to bleed margin!
================================================================================
"""

import csv
import os
import random
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

random.seed(42)

BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
RAW_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data", "raw")
os.makedirs(RAW_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# 1. Genuine Ekatunggal Group B2B Product Catalog
PRODUCTS = [
    {
        "sku": "EKA-SPR-01",
        "name": "Bonnell Spring Wire Coil (Kawat Per Kasur Pegas)",
        "category": "Material Springbed",
        "price": 1850000,
        "cogs": 1320000
    },
    {
        "sku": "EKA-SPR-02",
        "name": "Knitting Mattress Fabric 300gsm (Kain Rajut Quilting Kasur)",
        "category": "Kain Kasur",
        "price": 1250000,
        "cogs": 860000
    },
    {
        "sku": "EKA-FOM-01",
        "name": "High-Density Polyurethane Foam D28 (Busa Kasur & Sofa)",
        "category": "Busa Industri",
        "price": 950000,
        "cogs": 680000
    },
    {
        "sku": "EKA-SOF-01",
        "name": "Karet Webbing Sofa Elastis Heavy-Duty (Roll 100m)",
        "category": "Material Sofa",
        "price": 420000,
        "cogs": 290000
    },
    {
        "sku": "EKA-SOF-02",
        "name": "Kulit Sintetis Oscar Premium (Upholstery Faux Leather 40m)",
        "category": "Pelapis Sofa",
        "price": 1650000,
        "cogs": 1180000
    },
    {
        "sku": "EKA-ACC-01",
        "name": "Hard Felt Pad / Matras Pad Peredam Suara Per (Pack 10 pcs)",
        "category": "Aksesori Matras",
        "price": 540000,
        "cogs": 380000
    },
]

CITIES = [
    ("Bogor (Citeureup)", "Jawa Barat"),
    ("Jakarta Timur", "DKI Jakarta"),
    ("Sidoarjo", "Jawa Timur"),
    ("Surabaya", "Jawa Timur"),
    ("Semarang", "Jawa Tengah"),
    ("Jepara", "Jawa Tengah"),
    ("Makassar", "Sulawesi Selatan"),
    ("Samarinda", "Kalimantan Timur"),
    ("Balikpapan", "Kalimantan Timur"),
    ("Manado", "Sulawesi Utara"),
]

B2B_COMPANY_PREFIXES = ["PT", "CV", "UD", "Mebel", "Pabrik Kasur"]
B2B_COMPANY_NAMES = [
    "Cipta Mebel Nusantara", "Surya Kasur Abadi", "Kencana Springbed",
    "Prima Busa Mandiri", "Sentosa Furniture", "Jaya Matras Utama",
    "Megah Sofa Perkasa", "Agung Mebel Sejahtera", "Indo Kasur Gemilang",
    "Makmur Sofa Nusantara", "Nusantara Foam Lestari", "Harmoni Mebelindo"
]


def generate_datasets():
    start_date = datetime(2026, 1, 1)
    end_date = datetime(2026, 6, 30)
    total_days = (end_date - start_date).days + 1

    customers = []
    orders = []
    order_items = []
    ad_spend_rows = []

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 1A: Generate B2B Clients across 6 monthly cohorts (1,820 accounts)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    customer_id_counter = 1001
    for month in range(1, 7):
        cohort_start = datetime(2026, month, 1)
        if month == 6:
            cohort_end = datetime(2026, 6, 30)
        else:
            cohort_end = datetime(2026, month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)

        num_new_customers = random.randint(280, 330)
        for _ in range(num_new_customers):
            cid = f"CLIENT-{customer_id_counter}"
            customer_id_counter += 1

            acq_days_offset = random.randint(0, (cohort_end - cohort_start).days)
            reg_date = cohort_start + timedelta(
                days=acq_days_offset,
                hours=random.randint(7, 21),
                minutes=random.randint(0, 59)
            )

            # Channel Distribution: Cabang Luar Pulau (45%), Cabang Jawa (35%), Gudang Pusat (20%)
            r = random.random()
            if r < 0.45:
                acq_channel = "Cabang Luar Pulau"
                acq_campaign = random.choice(["B2B_Makassar_Wholesale", "B2B_Samarinda_Logistics", "B2B_Eastern_Trade"])
            elif r < 0.80:
                acq_channel = "Cabang Jawa"
                acq_campaign = random.choice(["B2B_Sidoarjo_Industrial", "B2B_Semarang_Distributor", "B2B_Jepara_Carpentry"])
            else:
                acq_channel = "Gudang Pusat"
                acq_campaign = random.choice(["B2B_Jabodetabek_Factory", "B2B_Direct_Citeureup", "B2B_KeyAccount_OEM"])

            city, province = random.choice(CITIES)
            prefix = random.choice(B2B_COMPANY_PREFIXES)
            cname = random.choice(B2B_COMPANY_NAMES)
            full_name = f"{prefix} {cname} {city.split()[0]}"
            email = f"purchasing@{cname.lower().replace(' ', '')}{cid[-3:]}.co.id"

            customers.append({
                "customer_id": cid,
                "full_name": full_name,
                "email": email,
                "city": city,
                "province": province,
                "acquisition_channel": acq_channel,
                "acquisition_campaign": acq_campaign,
                "created_at": reg_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                "_reg_dt": reg_date
            })

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 1B: Generate Purchase Orders & Repeat Orders (Cohort Dynamics)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    order_id_counter = 50001
    item_id_counter = 90001

    for cust in customers:
        cid = cust["customer_id"]
        channel = cust["acquisition_channel"]
        reg_dt = cust["_reg_dt"]

        if channel == "Cabang Luar Pulau":
            repeat_prob = 0.13
            max_repeats = 2
            discount_rate_range = (0.20, 0.35)
            fee_rate = 0.10  # 10% Inter-island maritime shipping & distributor fee
            cancel_return_prob = 0.14
        elif channel == "Cabang Jawa":
            repeat_prob = 0.28
            max_repeats = 3
            discount_rate_range = (0.10, 0.22)
            fee_rate = 0.08  # 8% Regional hub handling fee
            cancel_return_prob = 0.08
        else:  # Gudang Pusat (Direct Citeureup)
            repeat_prob = 0.48
            max_repeats = 5
            discount_rate_range = (0.0, 0.10)
            fee_rate = 0.025  # 2.5% Direct logistics handling fee
            cancel_return_prob = 0.03

        order_dates = [reg_dt]
        curr_dt = reg_dt
        for _ in range(max_repeats):
            if random.random() < repeat_prob:
                curr_dt = curr_dt + timedelta(days=random.randint(18, 55), hours=random.randint(1, 12))
                if curr_dt <= end_date:
                    order_dates.append(curr_dt)
            else:
                break

        for odt in order_dates:
            oid = f"PO-{order_id_counter}"
            order_id_counter += 1

            sr = random.random()
            if sr < cancel_return_prob * 0.55:
                status = "returned"
            elif sr < cancel_return_prob:
                status = "cancelled"
            else:
                status = "completed"

            num_items = random.choices([1, 2, 3], weights=[0.55, 0.32, 0.13])[0]
            chosen_products = random.sample(PRODUCTS, num_items)

            gross_amount = 0
            for prod in chosen_products:
                iid = f"ITM-{item_id_counter}"
                item_id_counter += 1
                qty = random.choices([1, 2], weights=[0.82, 0.18])[0]
                line_gross = prod["price"] * qty
                gross_amount += line_gross

                order_items.append({
                    "item_id": iid,
                    "order_id": oid,
                    "product_sku": prod["sku"],
                    "product_name": prod["name"],
                    "category": prod["category"],
                    "quantity": qty,
                    "unit_price": prod["price"],
                    "unit_cogs": prod["cogs"],
                    "line_gross_amount": line_gross,
                    "line_cogs_amount": prod["cogs"] * qty
                })

            disc_pct = random.uniform(*discount_rate_range)
            discount_amount = round(gross_amount * disc_pct, -2)
            after_discount = gross_amount - discount_amount

            if status == "completed":
                channel_fee = round(after_discount * fee_rate, -1)
                shipping_loss = 0
            elif status == "returned":
                channel_fee = 0
                shipping_loss = 150000  # Return freight penalty per pallet/batch
            else:
                channel_fee = 0
                shipping_loss = 0

            orders.append({
                "order_id": oid,
                "customer_id": cid,
                "channel": channel,
                "order_status": status,
                "order_date": odt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                "gross_amount": int(gross_amount),
                "discount_amount": int(discount_amount),
                "channel_fee_amount": int(channel_fee),
                "return_shipping_loss": int(shipping_loss),
                "payment_method": random.choice(["TOP 30 Hari", "TOP 60 Hari", "Bilyet Giro (BG)", "Bank Transfer", "Cash Before Delivery"])
            })

    # Injected 15 duplicate ERP webhook/sync rows
    duplicate_samples = random.sample(orders, 15)
    orders_with_dups = orders + duplicate_samples

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 1C: Generate B2B Trade & Marketing Spend
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    campaigns = [
        {"platform": "B2B Field Marketing", "target_channel": "Cabang Luar Pulau", "campaign_name": "B2B_Makassar_Wholesale", "daily_budget": (1600000, 2600000)},
        {"platform": "B2B Trade Exhibition", "target_channel": "Cabang Luar Pulau", "campaign_name": "B2B_Samarinda_Logistics", "daily_budget": (900000, 1500000)},
        {"platform": "Industry Catalog Ads", "target_channel": "Cabang Jawa", "campaign_name": "B2B_Sidoarjo_Industrial", "daily_budget": (850000, 1450000)},
        {"platform": "Key Account Sales", "target_channel": "Gudang Pusat", "campaign_name": "B2B_Jabodetabek_Factory", "daily_budget": (650000, 1150000)},
    ]

    for day_idx in range(total_days):
        curr_date = (start_date + timedelta(days=day_idx)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        for camp in campaigns:
            spend = round(random.uniform(*camp["daily_budget"]), -3)
            impressions = int(spend / random.uniform(18, 32))
            clicks = int(impressions * random.uniform(0.014, 0.032))
            ad_spend_rows.append({
                "spend_date": curr_date,
                "platform": camp["platform"],
                "target_channel": camp["target_channel"],
                "campaign_name": camp["campaign_name"],
                "spend_idr": int(spend),
                "impressions": impressions,
                "clicks": clicks
            })

    for row in customers:
        row.pop("_reg_dt", None)

    def write_csv(filename, data):
        filepath = os.path.join(RAW_DIR, filename)
        with open(filepath, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=data[0].keys())
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(data)
        print(f"[GENERATED] {filename}: {len(data):,} rows -> {filepath}")

    write_csv("customers.csv", customers)
    write_csv("orders.csv", orders_with_dups)
    write_csv("order_items.csv", order_items)
    write_csv("ad_spend.csv", ad_spend_rows)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate_datasets()
code_repository.py_02_ingestion:
"""
================================================================================
STEP 2: IDEMPOTENT ELT INGESTION PIPELINE TO DUCKDB DATA WAREHOUSE
Project: Aura Botanicals - End-to-End Analytics Pipeline
Role: Senior Data Analyst (5 Years Experience)
================================================================================
Engineering Principles Applied:
1. ELT Paradigm (Extract, Load, Transform):
   - Load raw CSV files untouched into the `raw_bronze` schema in DuckDB.
   - Never mutate raw data during ingestion so we always retain an audit trail.
2. Idempotency:
   - Using `CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE raw_bronze.<table_name>` (or partition overwrite)
     ensures running the pipeline 1 time or 100 times produces the exact same
     state without duplicating records.
3. Metadata Audit Columns:
   - Every table gets `_ingested_at` (UTC timestamp) and `_source_file` for lineage.
4. Data Quality Gate (Pre-flight Check):
   - Verifies row counts > 0 and checks required columns before committing.
================================================================================
"""

import os
import time
import duckdb
from datetime import datetime

BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
RAW_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data", "raw")
WAREHOUSE_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data", "warehouse")
os.makedirs(WAREHOUSE_DIR, exist_ok=True)

DB_PATH = os.path.join(WAREHOUSE_DIR, "aura_analytics.duckdb")


def run_ingestion():
    print("=" * 72)
    print("[START] STEP 2: IDEMPOTENT ELT INGESTION TO DUCKDB")
    print("=" * 72)

    conn = duckdb.connect(DB_PATH)

    # Create Medallion Architecture Schemas
    schemas = ["raw_bronze", "stg_silver", "mart_gold"]
    for schema in schemas:
        conn.execute(f"CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {schema};")

    # Audit log table to track pipeline runs
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS raw_bronze._pipeline_audit_log (
            run_id VARCHAR,
            table_name VARCHAR,
            source_file VARCHAR,
            rows_loaded INTEGER,
            duration_ms DOUBLE,
            status VARCHAR,
            executed_at TIMESTAMP
        );
    """)

    tables_to_ingest = [
        ("raw_customers", "customers.csv"),
        ("raw_orders", "orders.csv"),
        ("raw_order_items", "order_items.csv"),
        ("raw_ad_spend", "ad_spend.csv"),
    ]

    run_id = f"RUN-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}"
    ingestion_summary = []

    for table_name, csv_filename in tables_to_ingest:
        csv_path = os.path.join(RAW_DIR, csv_filename).replace("\\", "/")
        if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Source file missing: {csv_path}")

        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        # Idempotent Load with Lineage Metadata
        query = f"""
            CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE raw_bronze.{table_name} AS
            SELECT 
                *,
                CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS _ingested_at,
                '{csv_filename}' AS _source_file,
                '{run_id}' AS _batch_run_id
            FROM read_csv_auto('{csv_path}', header=True);
        """
        conn.execute(query)

        row_count = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_bronze.{table_name}").fetchone()[0]
        duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000, 2)

        # Quality Gate: Ensure non-empty load
        status = "SUCCESS" if row_count > 0 else "EMPTY_ERROR"

        conn.execute("""
            INSERT INTO raw_bronze._pipeline_audit_log
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        """, [run_id, f"raw_bronze.{table_name}", csv_filename, row_count, duration_ms, status])

        print(f"  [OK] Loaded raw_bronze.{table_name:<18} | Rows: {row_count:>6,} | Time: {duration_ms:>6.2f} ms")
        ingestion_summary.append({
            "table": f"raw_bronze.{table_name}",
            "source": csv_filename,
            "rows": row_count,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "status": status
        })

    conn.close()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"[DONE] INGESTION COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY -> {DB_PATH}")
    print("=" * 72)
    return ingestion_summary


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_ingestion()

-- =============================================================================
-- STEP 3A: STAGING LAYER (stg_silver)
-- Purpose: Deduplication, Data Type Casting, String Normalization, Null Handling
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. Staging Customers: Normalize email & trim strings
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE stg_silver.stg_customers AS
WITH deduplicated AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(customer_id) AS customer_id,
        TRIM(full_name) AS full_name,
        LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email,
        TRIM(city) AS city,
        TRIM(province) AS province,
        TRIM(acquisition_channel) AS acquisition_channel,
        TRIM(acquisition_campaign) AS acquisition_campaign,
        CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS registered_at,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP))::DATE AS cohort_month,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at ASC) AS rn
    FROM raw_bronze.raw_customers
)
SELECT * EXCLUDE (rn)
FROM deduplicated
WHERE rn = 1;

-- 2. Staging Orders: Remove duplicate webhook/ingestion records (15 duplicates injected)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE stg_silver.stg_orders AS
WITH ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(order_id) AS order_id,
        TRIM(customer_id) AS customer_id,
        TRIM(channel) AS channel,
        LOWER(TRIM(order_status)) AS order_status,
        CAST(order_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS ordered_at,
        CAST(order_date AS DATE) AS order_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_date AS DATE))::DATE AS order_month,
        CAST(gross_amount AS BIGINT) AS gross_amount_idr,
        CAST(discount_amount AS BIGINT) AS discount_amount_idr,
        CAST(channel_fee_amount AS BIGINT) AS channel_fee_idr,
        CAST(return_shipping_loss AS BIGINT) AS return_shipping_loss_idr,
        TRIM(payment_method) AS payment_method,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TRIM(order_id)
            ORDER BY _ingested_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM raw_bronze.raw_orders
)
SELECT * EXCLUDE (rn)
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE rn = 1;

-- 3. Staging Order Items: Clean SKU & line financials
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE stg_silver.stg_order_items AS
SELECT
    TRIM(item_id) AS item_id,
    TRIM(order_id) AS order_id,
    TRIM(product_sku) AS product_sku,
    TRIM(product_name) AS product_name,
    TRIM(category) AS category,
    CAST(quantity AS INTEGER) AS quantity,
    CAST(unit_price AS BIGINT) AS unit_price_idr,
    CAST(unit_cogs AS BIGINT) AS unit_cogs_idr,
    CAST(line_gross_amount AS BIGINT) AS line_gross_idr,
    CAST(line_cogs_amount AS BIGINT) AS line_cogs_idr
FROM raw_bronze.raw_order_items;

-- 4. Staging Ad Spend: Daily marketing spend per channel & campaign
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE stg_silver.stg_ad_spend AS
SELECT
    CAST(spend_date AS DATE) AS spend_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(spend_date AS DATE))::DATE AS spend_month,
    TRIM(platform) AS ad_platform,
    TRIM(target_channel) AS target_channel,
    TRIM(campaign_name) AS campaign_name,
    CAST(spend_idr AS BIGINT) AS spend_idr,
    CAST(impressions AS INTEGER) AS impressions,
    CAST(clicks AS INTEGER) AS clicks
FROM raw_bronze.raw_ad_spend;
code_repository.sql_02_dimensions:
-- =============================================================================
-- STEP 3B: KIMBALL DIMENSION TABLES (mart_gold.dim_*)
-- Purpose: Enrich Customer & Product Attributes for Slicing & Segmentation
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. Dimension Products: Catalog with Gross Margin Profile
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mart_gold.dim_products AS
SELECT
    product_sku,
    ANY_VALUE(product_name) AS product_name,
    ANY_VALUE(category) AS category,
    MAX(unit_price_idr) AS unit_price_idr,
    MAX(unit_cogs_idr) AS unit_cogs_idr,
    MAX(unit_price_idr) - MAX(unit_cogs_idr) AS unit_gross_margin_idr,
    ROUND(
        (MAX(unit_price_idr) - MAX(unit_cogs_idr)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(MAX(unit_price_idr), 0),
        2
    ) AS product_gross_margin_pct,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_units_ordered
FROM stg_silver.stg_order_items
GROUP BY product_sku
ORDER BY product_sku;

-- 2. Dimension Customers: Enriched with Order History & RFM Attributes
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mart_gold.dim_customers AS
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'completed') AS completed_orders_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status IN ('cancelled', 'returned')) AS failed_orders_count,
        MIN(order_date) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'completed') AS first_completed_order_date,
        MAX(order_date) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'completed') AS last_completed_order_date,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(gross_amount_idr - discount_amount_idr) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'completed'),
            0
        ) AS lifetime_net_sales_idr,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(gross_amount_idr) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'completed'),
            0
        ) AS lifetime_gross_sales_idr
    FROM stg_silver.stg_orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    c.email,
    c.city,
    c.province,
    c.acquisition_channel,
    c.acquisition_campaign,
    c.registered_at,
    c.cohort_month,
    COALESCE(co.completed_orders_count, 0) AS completed_orders,
    COALESCE(co.failed_orders_count, 0) AS failed_orders,
    co.first_completed_order_date,
    co.last_completed_order_date,
    COALESCE(co.lifetime_net_sales_idr, 0) AS ltv_net_sales_idr,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(co.completed_orders_count, 0) > 1 THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_repeat_buyer,
    DATE_DIFF('day', co.last_completed_order_date, DATE '2026-06-30') AS recency_days
FROM stg_silver.stg_customers c
LEFT JOIN customer_orders co
    ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id;

-- =============================================================================
-- STEP 3C: KIMBALL FACT TABLE (mart_gold.fct_orders)
-- Purpose: Order-level Unit Economics (Gross -> Discount -> Fee -> COGS -> Margin)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mart_gold.fct_orders AS
WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_items_qty,
        SUM(line_cogs_idr) AS total_cogs_idr
    FROM stg_silver.stg_order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
order_sequencing AS (
    SELECT
        o.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.customer_id
            ORDER BY o.ordered_at ASC
        ) AS customer_order_seq
    FROM stg_silver.stg_orders o
)
SELECT
    os.order_id,
    os.customer_id,
    c.cohort_month AS customer_cohort_month,
    c.acquisition_channel,
    c.acquisition_campaign,
    os.channel AS sales_channel,
    os.order_status,
    os.ordered_at,
    os.order_date,
    os.order_month,
    os.payment_method,
    os.customer_order_seq,
    CASE WHEN os.customer_order_seq = 1 THEN 'New Customer Order' ELSE 'Repeat Order' END AS buyer_type,
    COALESCE(it.total_items_qty, 0) AS total_items_qty,

    -- Gross Revenue (Reported by Marketing / Dashboard GMV)
    os.gross_amount_idr AS gmv_gross_idr,

    -- Realized Revenue (Only Completed Orders count toward Net Sales)
    CASE WHEN os.order_status = 'completed' THEN os.gross_amount_idr ELSE 0 END AS realized_gross_idr,
    CASE WHEN os.order_status = 'completed' THEN os.discount_amount_idr ELSE 0 END AS discount_idr,
    CASE
        WHEN os.order_status = 'completed'
        THEN (os.gross_amount_idr - os.discount_amount_idr)
        ELSE 0
    END AS net_sales_idr,

    -- Variable Costs (COGS, Platform Commission Fee, Return Shipping Penalty)
    CASE WHEN os.order_status = 'completed' THEN os.channel_fee_idr ELSE 0 END AS marketplace_fee_idr,
    CASE WHEN os.order_status = 'completed' THEN COALESCE(it.total_cogs_idr, 0) ELSE 0 END AS cogs_idr,
    os.return_shipping_loss_idr,

    -- Contribution Margin Before Marketing (CM1)
    CASE
        WHEN os.order_status = 'completed'
        THEN (os.gross_amount_idr - os.discount_amount_idr - os.channel_fee_idr - COALESCE(it.total_cogs_idr, 0))
        ELSE -os.return_shipping_loss_idr
    END AS contribution_margin_before_ads_idr
FROM order_sequencing os
LEFT JOIN item_totals it
    ON os.order_id = it.order_id
LEFT JOIN stg_silver.stg_customers c
    ON os.customer_id = c.customer_id;

-- =============================================================================
-- STEP 3D: EXECUTIVE GOLD MARTS (mart_gold.mart_*)
-- Purpose: Pre-aggregated Business Marts for BI Dashboard & C-Level Reporting
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. Mart Channel & Monthly Unit Economics (Exposing the ROAS Illusion)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mart_gold.mart_channel_unit_economics AS
WITH order_agg AS (
    SELECT
        order_month,
        sales_channel AS channel,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'completed') AS completed_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') AS returned_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE buyer_type = 'New Customer Order' AND order_status = 'completed') AS new_paying_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE buyer_type = 'Repeat Order' AND order_status = 'completed') AS repeat_customers,
        SUM(gmv_gross_idr) AS gmv_gross_idr,
        SUM(realized_gross_idr) AS realized_gross_idr,
        SUM(discount_idr) AS discount_idr,
        SUM(net_sales_idr) AS net_sales_idr,
        SUM(marketplace_fee_idr) AS marketplace_fee_idr,
        SUM(cogs_idr) AS cogs_idr,
        SUM(return_shipping_loss_idr) AS return_shipping_loss_idr,
        SUM(contribution_margin_before_ads_idr) AS cm_before_ads_idr
    FROM mart_gold.fct_orders
    GROUP BY order_month, sales_channel
),
ad_agg AS (
    SELECT
        spend_month,
        target_channel AS channel,
        SUM(spend_idr) AS ad_spend_idr,
        SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
        SUM(clicks) AS clicks
    FROM stg_silver.stg_ad_spend
    GROUP BY spend_month, target_channel
)
SELECT
    oa.order_month,
    STRFTIME(oa.order_month, '%Y-%m') AS year_month,
    oa.channel,
    oa.total_orders,
    oa.completed_orders,
    oa.returned_orders,
    oa.cancelled_orders,
    oa.new_paying_customers,
    oa.repeat_customers,
    oa.gmv_gross_idr,
    oa.realized_gross_idr,
    oa.discount_idr,
    oa.net_sales_idr,
    oa.marketplace_fee_idr,
    oa.cogs_idr,
    oa.return_shipping_loss_idr,
    oa.cm_before_ads_idr,
    COALESCE(aa.ad_spend_idr, 0) AS ad_spend_idr,
    -- Net Contribution Margin (Real Profit after COGS, Fees, Discounts, and Ads)
    (oa.cm_before_ads_idr - COALESCE(aa.ad_spend_idr, 0)) AS net_profit_idr,
    -- Vanity ROAS (What agency reports: GMV / Ad Spend)
    ROUND(oa.gmv_gross_idr * 1.0 / NULLIF(aa.ad_spend_idr, 0), 2) AS vanity_roas,
    -- Real Profit ROAS (Net Contribution Before Ads / Ad Spend)
    ROUND(oa.cm_before_ads_idr * 1.0 / NULLIF(aa.ad_spend_idr, 0), 2) AS contribution_roas,
    -- Blended CAC (Ad Spend / New Paying Customers)
    ROUND(COALESCE(aa.ad_spend_idr, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(oa.new_paying_customers, 0), 0) AS cac_idr,
    -- Net Profit Margin % (of Net Sales)
    ROUND((oa.cm_before_ads_idr - COALESCE(aa.ad_spend_idr, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(oa.net_sales_idr, 0), 2) AS net_margin_pct
FROM order_agg oa
LEFT JOIN ad_agg aa
    ON oa.order_month = aa.spend_month
   AND oa.channel = aa.channel
ORDER BY oa.order_month, oa.channel;

-- 2. Mart Cohort Retention Matrix (M0 to M5)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mart_gold.mart_cohort_retention AS
WITH completed_user_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer_id,
        customer_cohort_month AS cohort_month,
        acquisition_channel,
        order_month,
        DATE_DIFF('month', customer_cohort_month, order_month) AS month_number
    FROM mart_gold.fct_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'completed'
      AND customer_cohort_month IS NOT NULL
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM completed_user_months
    WHERE month_number = 0
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
retention_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        month_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM completed_user_months
    WHERE month_number BETWEEN 0 AND 5
    GROUP BY cohort_month, month_number
)
SELECT
    STRFTIME(rc.cohort_month, '%Y-%m') AS cohort_month,
    cs.cohort_size,
    rc.month_number,
    rc.active_customers,
    ROUND(rc.active_customers * 100.0 / NULLIF(cs.cohort_size, 0), 1) AS retention_pct
FROM retention_counts rc
JOIN cohort_sizes cs
    ON rc.cohort_month = cs.cohort_month
ORDER BY rc.cohort_month, rc.month_number;

-- 3. Mart RFM Customer Segmentation
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mart_gold.mart_rfm_segments AS
WITH rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        full_name,
        acquisition_channel,
        recency_days,
        completed_orders AS frequency,
        ltv_net_sales_idr AS monetary_idr,
        CASE
            WHEN recency_days <= 30 THEN 4
            WHEN recency_days <= 60 THEN 3
            WHEN recency_days <= 90 THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS r_score,
        CASE
            WHEN completed_orders >= 4 THEN 4
            WHEN completed_orders = 3 THEN 3
            WHEN completed_orders = 2 THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS f_score,
        CASE
            WHEN ltv_net_sales_idr >= 800000 THEN 4
            WHEN ltv_net_sales_idr >= 450000 THEN 3
            WHEN ltv_net_sales_idr >= 200000 THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS m_score
    FROM mart_gold.dim_customers
    WHERE completed_orders > 0
)
SELECT
    *,
    CASE
        WHEN r_score >= 3 AND f_score >= 3 THEN 'Champions (Loyalists)'
        WHEN r_score >= 3 AND f_score = 2 THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
        WHEN r_score <= 2 AND f_score >= 2 THEN 'At-Risk Repeat Buyers'
        WHEN r_score >= 3 AND f_score = 1 THEN 'Recent One-Time Buyers'
        ELSE 'Churned Promo Hunters'
    END AS rfm_segment
FROM rfm_scores;
code_repository.py_03_analytics:
"""
================================================================================
STEP 3 & 4: SQL MODELING RUNNER, DATA QUALITY TESTS & ANALYTICS EXPORT
Project: Aura Botanicals - End-to-End Analytics Pipeline
Role: Senior Data Analyst (5 Years Experience)
================================================================================
What this script does:
1. Executes Medallion SQL transformations (01_staging -> 02_dimensions -> 03_facts -> 04_marts)
   inside DuckDB.
2. Runs automated Data Quality Assertions (uniqueness, row deduplication check, null tests).
3. Extracts deep-dive analytical views (Unit Economics, Waterfall, Cohort Matrix,
   Channel Retention, RFM Segmentation, Product Margin, Sample Tables) into a
   structured JSON bundle for the React Interactive Portal & Dashboard.
================================================================================
"""

import json
import os
import time
import duckdb

BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WAREHOUSE_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data", "warehouse")
SQL_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "src", "sql")
FRONTEND_DATA_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "frontend", "src", "data")
os.makedirs(FRONTEND_DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

DB_PATH = os.path.join(WAREHOUSE_DIR, "aura_analytics.duckdb")


def execute_transformations_and_export():
    print("=" * 72)
    print("[START] RUNNING STEP 3: MEDALLION SQL TRANSFORMATIONS IN DUCKDB")
    print("=" * 72)

    conn = duckdb.connect(DB_PATH)

    sql_files = [
        "01_staging.sql",
        "02_dimensions.sql",
        "03_facts.sql",
        "04_marts.sql",
    ]

    sql_contents = {}
    transformation_logs = []

    for fname in sql_files:
        fpath = os.path.join(SQL_DIR, fname)
        with open(fpath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            sql_text = f.read()
        sql_contents[fname] = sql_text

        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        conn.execute(sql_text)
        elapsed = round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000, 2)
        print(f"  [OK] Executed {fname:<22} | Duration: {elapsed:>6.2f} ms")
        transformation_logs.append({"file": fname, "duration_ms": elapsed, "status": "PASSED"})

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # DATA QUALITY TESTS (Senior Analyst Best Practice)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n[CHECK] RUNNING DATA QUALITY & INTEGRITY TESTS:")
    raw_orders_cnt = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_bronze.raw_orders").fetchone()[0]
    stg_orders_cnt = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_silver.stg_orders").fetchone()[0]
    dup_removed = raw_orders_cnt - stg_orders_cnt

    pk_dups = conn.execute("""
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
            SELECT order_id FROM mart_gold.fct_orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
    """).fetchone()[0]

    null_cust = conn.execute("""
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_gold.fct_orders WHERE customer_id IS NULL
    """).fetchone()[0]

    dq_results = [
        {
            "test_name": "Deduplication Check (raw_orders -> stg_orders)",
            "expected": "Remove injected webhook duplicates",
            "actual": f"{raw_orders_cnt:,} raw -> {stg_orders_cnt:,} clean ({dup_removed} duplicates removed)",
            "status": "PASSED" if dup_removed == 15 else "WARNING"
        },
        {
            "test_name": "Primary Key Uniqueness (mart_gold.fct_orders.order_id)",
            "expected": "0 duplicate order_ids",
            "actual": f"{pk_dups} duplicates found",
            "status": "PASSED" if pk_dups == 0 else "FAILED"
        },
        {
            "test_name": "Referential Integrity (fct_orders.customer_id NOT NULL)",
            "expected": "0 orphan orders",
            "actual": f"{null_cust} null customer_ids",
            "status": "PASSED" if null_cust == 0 else "FAILED"
        }
    ]
    for dq in dq_results:
        print(f"  [OK] {dq['test_name']}: {dq['actual']} ({dq['status']})")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 4: EXTRACT EXECUTIVE ANALYTICS & DEEP-DIVE METRICS
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def query_dicts(sql):
        df = conn.execute(sql).fetchdf()
        # Convert any dates/timestamps to string for JSON serialization
        for col in df.columns:
            if "date" in col or "month" in col or "_at" in col:
                df[col] = df[col].astype(str)
        return df.to_dict(orient="records")

    # 1. Monthly & Channel Unit Economics
    channel_monthly = query_dicts("SELECT * FROM mart_gold.mart_channel_unit_economics ORDER BY year_month, channel")

    # 2. Channel Summary Totals (6 Months Combined)
    channel_summary = query_dicts("""
        SELECT
            channel,
            SUM(total_orders)::INT AS total_orders,
            SUM(completed_orders)::INT AS completed_orders,
            SUM(returned_orders)::INT AS returned_orders,
            SUM(cancelled_orders)::INT AS cancelled_orders,
            ROUND((SUM(returned_orders) + SUM(cancelled_orders)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_orders), 0), 1) AS fail_rate_pct,
            SUM(new_paying_customers)::INT AS new_customers,
            SUM(repeat_customers)::INT AS repeat_orders,
            SUM(gmv_gross_idr)::BIGINT AS gmv_gross_idr,
            SUM(realized_gross_idr)::BIGINT AS realized_gross_idr,
            SUM(discount_idr)::BIGINT AS discount_idr,
            SUM(net_sales_idr)::BIGINT AS net_sales_idr,
            SUM(marketplace_fee_idr)::BIGINT AS marketplace_fee_idr,
            SUM(cogs_idr)::BIGINT AS cogs_idr,
            SUM(return_shipping_loss_idr)::BIGINT AS return_shipping_loss_idr,
            SUM(cm_before_ads_idr)::BIGINT AS cm_before_ads_idr,
            SUM(ad_spend_idr)::BIGINT AS ad_spend_idr,
            SUM(net_profit_idr)::BIGINT AS net_profit_idr,
            ROUND(SUM(gmv_gross_idr) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend_idr), 0), 2) AS vanity_roas,
            ROUND(SUM(cm_before_ads_idr) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend_idr), 0), 2) AS contribution_roas,
            ROUND(SUM(ad_spend_idr) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(new_paying_customers), 0), 0)::BIGINT AS cac_idr,
            ROUND(SUM(net_profit_idr) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(net_sales_idr), 0), 1) AS net_margin_pct
        FROM mart_gold.mart_channel_unit_economics
        GROUP BY channel
        ORDER BY gmv_gross_idr DESC
    """)

    # 3. Channel LTV vs CAC Comparison
    ltv_cac_by_channel = query_dicts("""
        WITH cust_ltv AS (
            SELECT
                acquisition_channel AS channel,
                COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE completed_orders > 0) AS paying_customers,
                COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE is_repeat_buyer = TRUE) AS repeat_buyers,
                ROUND(
                    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE is_repeat_buyer = TRUE) * 100.0 /
                    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE completed_orders > 0), 0),
                    1
                ) AS repeat_buyer_rate_pct,
                ROUND(AVG(ltv_net_sales_idr) FILTER (WHERE completed_orders > 0), 0)::BIGINT AS avg_ltv_net_sales_idr,
                ROUND(AVG(completed_orders) FILTER (WHERE completed_orders > 0), 2) AS avg_orders_per_buyer
            FROM mart_gold.dim_customers
            GROUP BY acquisition_channel
        ),
        chan_cm AS (
            SELECT
                channel,
                ROUND(SUM(cm_before_ads_idr) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(new_paying_customers), 0), 0)::BIGINT AS ltv_contribution_margin_idr,
                ROUND(SUM(ad_spend_idr) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(new_paying_customers), 0), 0)::BIGINT AS cac_idr
            FROM mart_gold.mart_channel_unit_economics
            GROUP BY channel
        )
        SELECT
            l.channel,
            l.paying_customers,
            l.repeat_buyers,
            l.repeat_buyer_rate_pct,
            l.avg_orders_per_buyer,
            l.avg_ltv_net_sales_idr,
            c.ltv_contribution_margin_idr,
            c.cac_idr,
            ROUND(c.ltv_contribution_margin_idr * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.cac_idr, 0), 2) AS ltv_to_cac_ratio
        FROM cust_ltv l
        JOIN chan_cm c ON l.channel = c.channel
        ORDER BY ltv_to_cac_ratio DESC
    """)

    # 4. Cohort Retention Matrix (Overall)
    cohort_matrix = query_dicts("SELECT * FROM mart_gold.mart_cohort_retention ORDER BY cohort_month, month_number")

    # 5. Cohort Retention by Acquisition Channel (M0 to M3 average retention)
    channel_retention_curve = query_dicts("""
        WITH user_months AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                customer_id,
                customer_cohort_month,
                acquisition_channel AS channel,
                DATE_DIFF('month', customer_cohort_month, order_month) AS month_number
            FROM mart_gold.fct_orders
            WHERE order_status = 'completed'
        ),
        base AS (
            SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS base_users
            FROM user_months WHERE month_number = 0
            GROUP BY channel
        )
        SELECT
            u.channel,
            u.month_number,
            COUNT(DISTINCT u.customer_id)::INT AS active_users,
            b.base_users::INT AS base_users,
            ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT u.customer_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(b.base_users, 0), 1) AS retention_pct
        FROM user_months u
        JOIN base b ON u.channel = b.channel
        WHERE u.month_number BETWEEN 0 AND 4
        GROUP BY u.channel, u.month_number, b.base_users
        ORDER BY u.channel, u.month_number
    """)

    # 6. RFM Segments Summary
    rfm_summary = query_dicts("""
        SELECT
            rfm_segment,
            COUNT(*)::INT AS customer_count,
            ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct,
            ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 0)::INT AS avg_recency_days,
            ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_frequency,
            ROUND(AVG(monetary_idr), 0)::BIGINT AS avg_monetary_idr,
            SUM(monetary_idr)::BIGINT AS total_revenue_idr
        FROM mart_gold.mart_rfm_segments
        GROUP BY rfm_segment
        ORDER BY total_revenue_idr DESC
    """)

    # 7. Product Performance
    product_performance = query_dicts("SELECT * FROM mart_gold.dim_products ORDER BY total_units_ordered DESC")

    # 8. Sample Preview Rows for Step 1, Step 2, Step 3 Data Inspector
    samples = {
        "raw_orders": query_dicts("SELECT order_id, customer_id, channel, order_status, order_date, gross_amount, discount_amount, channel_fee_amount, _ingested_at FROM raw_bronze.raw_orders LIMIT 8"),
        "raw_customers": query_dicts("SELECT customer_id, full_name, city, acquisition_channel, acquisition_campaign, created_at FROM raw_bronze.raw_customers LIMIT 8"),
        "raw_ad_spend": query_dicts("SELECT spend_date, platform, target_channel, campaign_name, spend_idr, impressions, clicks FROM raw_bronze.raw_ad_spend LIMIT 8"),
        "fct_orders": query_dicts("SELECT order_id, customer_id, sales_channel, buyer_type, order_status, gmv_gross_idr, discount_idr, net_sales_idr, marketplace_fee_idr, cogs_idr, contribution_margin_before_ads_idr FROM mart_gold.fct_orders LIMIT 8"),
        "dim_customers": query_dicts("SELECT customer_id, full_name, acquisition_channel, cohort_month, completed_orders, ltv_net_sales_idr, is_repeat_buyer, recency_days FROM mart_gold.dim_customers WHERE completed_orders > 0 LIMIT 8"),
        "audit_log": query_dicts("SELECT run_id, table_name, source_file, rows_loaded, duration_ms, status, executed_at FROM raw_bronze._pipeline_audit_log ORDER BY executed_at DESC LIMIT 8"),
    }

    # Read Python source files so the frontend Educational Portal can display the exact code
    with open(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "src", "01_data_generator.py"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        py_step1_code = f.read()
    with open(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "src", "02_ingestion.py"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        py_step2_code = f.read()
    with open(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "src", "03_analytics_deepdive.py"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        py_step4_code = f.read()

    payload = {
        "generated_at": "2026-10-16 21:05:00",
        "warehouse_engine": f"DuckDB v{duckdb.__version__} (OLAP Columnar Storage)",
        "dq_results": dq_results,
        "transformation_logs": transformation_logs,
        "channel_monthly": channel_monthly,
        "channel_summary": channel_summary,
        "ltv_cac_by_channel": ltv_cac_by_channel,
        "cohort_matrix": cohort_matrix,
        "channel_retention_curve": channel_retention_curve,
        "rfm_summary": rfm_summary,
        "product_performance": product_performance,
        "samples": samples,
        "code_repository": {
            "py_01_generator": py_step1_code,
            "py_02_ingestion": py_step2_code,
            "sql_01_staging": sql_contents["01_staging.sql"],
            "sql_02_dimensions": sql_contents["02_dimensions.sql"],
            "sql_03_facts": sql_contents["03_facts.sql"],
            "sql_04_marts": sql_contents["04_marts.sql"],
            "py_03_analytics": py_step4_code,
        }
    }

    out_json = os.path.join(FRONTEND_DATA_DIR, "analytics_payload.json")
    with open(out_json, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(payload, f, indent=2)

    conn.close()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"[DONE] EXPORTED FULL ANALYTICS PAYLOAD -> {out_json}")
    print("=" * 72)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    execute_transformations_and_export()
